name: Hearth-smoked buffalo
summary: Thịt trâu gác bếp is the buffalo Bao Son La names for Thai and Muong cooking on the plateau, and that the national authority calls a Black Thai specialty. It is kept apart from thịt hun khói and from thịt trâu khô. A smoke time was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Moc Chau. Bao Son La, 17 February 2023. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s attractions feature calls it a Black Thai dish.
howToEat: Eat it as a plateau plate. A cut, a seasoning, and a smoke time were not printed. Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: The Thai and Muong table on the plateau. A street was not printed. Check on arrival. A visitor quoted by Bao Son La names it among the plates she orders.
